description: This file contains utility functions and classes for handling source partitions within the torch.fx graph, including functions to get source partitions and check subgraph connectivity, as well as the SourcePartition data class.

classes.name: SourcePartition
classes.description: Data class representing a partition of nodes in a graph, including source info, input/output nodes, and parameters.

methods.name: _init_logger
methods.description: Initializes and configures a logger based on environment variable PYTORCH_MATCHER_LOGLEVEL.

methods.name: get_source_partitions
methods.description: Partitions a graph into source-based subgraphs based on wanted sources and optional filtering.

methods.name: check_subgraphs_connected
methods.description: Checks if two subgraphs are connected via at least one node in the other.
